sahin_2017.expression_direction_note: Expression negatively correlated with immunogenicity in Sahin 2017 (immunogenic mean TPM=50.1, non-immunogenic mean TPM=54.3, AUC=0.44). Possible immune editing signal: highly expressed neoantigens may be preferentially eliminated under immune pressure. Requires investigation.
sahin_2017.sahin_best_strategy_note: Best strategy uses all_volume (20%) not expression, suggesting peptide physicochemical properties carry more signal than expression in this cohort.
